body:
## Summary
- clarify that macOS Host compatibility rows require Screen Recording, Accessibility, and Microphone TCC evidence in README/testing guidance
- allow Phase 0 aggregate-only refresh commits to include the aggregate gate test fixture
- cover that source-guard path in the aggregate successor test

## Verification
- PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=tools python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_phase0_stable_release tools.tests.test_macos_hardware_compatibility -v
- make evidence-tools-test
- make phase0-stable-release-gate PHASE0_STABLE_RELEASE_EXPECTED_SOURCE_COMMIT=19a5e03a5804fc20ab0a14a70f0e3aa25b99b309 PHASE0_STABLE_RELEASE_SUMMARY=.build/evidence/phase0-stable-release/audit-macos-host-compat-summary-final.json (exits 0; reports aggregate_verdict=insufficient, readme_guard=pass, macos_host_hardware_compatibility_matrix=open/can_close=false, and source_guard=insufficient because this PR intentionally changes docs/testing and the checker)
- make phase0-stable-release-gate PHASE0_STABLE_RELEASE_EXPECTED_SOURCE_COMMIT=655646b09bb6a5e80e0689f2ea9e78b3bc574308 PHASE0_STABLE_RELEASE_REQUIRE_PASS=1 PHASE0_STABLE_RELEASE_SUMMARY=.build/evidence/phase0-stable-release/audit-macos-host-compat-require-pass-summary.json (expected nonzero while Phase 0 remains blocked)

No Host/GUI was launched, no swift run was used, no TCC/System Settings/Keychain changes were made, and no adb reverse mapping was created.
title: docs: clarify macOS compatibility TCC gates
